map.「按进料量与各产品产量核算收率与物料平衡」按输入参数进行专业计算并输出结果。: "Check the yield and mass balance from the feed quantity and the output of each product" — the tool runs a professional calculation from the input parameters and outputs the result.

map.常减压/裂解装置物料平衡：给定进料量(吨)与各馏分产量，工具逐产品算收率并汇总总: Atmospheric, vacuum and cracking unit mass balance: given the feed quantity (tonnes) and the output of each fraction, the tool computes the yield per product and totals the overall yield plus loss or residue, to judge whether the unit is running in balance.
map.方案比选：对比不同操作条件下的产品分布(如多产丙烯方案)，用收率条形直观比较各馏: Scheme comparison: compare the product distributions under different operating conditions (for example a propylene-maximising scheme); the yield bars give a direct visual comparison of each fraction’s share to support process optimisation.
map.损耗核查：当总收率明显偏离 100%(损失率>5%)会高亮「偏差较大」，提示计量: Loss audit: when the total yield deviates noticeably from 100% (loss rate > 5%), a large-deviation warning is highlighted, pointing to a metering error or to by-products and loss items that were not accounted for.
map.算例：进料 1000 吨的两产品分布: Worked example: two-product distribution with 1000 t of feed
map.进料 feed=1000 t，产品 乙烯 480 t、丙烯 290 t（其余为副:
Feed = 1000 t, products: ethylene 480 t, propylene 290 t (the rest is by-product and loss, not listed separately).
Ethylene yield = 480/1000 × 100% = 48.0%; propylene yield = 290/1000 × 100% = 29.0%; total products = 770 t; total yield = 77.0%; loss or residue = 1000 − 770 = 230 t; loss rate = 23.0%. A loss rate above 5% is judged a large deviation, so check by-product metering or loss items.
map.收率和物料平衡怎么算？: How are yield and mass balance calculated?
map.单产品收率=该产品产量÷进料量×100%；总收率=所有产品产量之和÷进料量×10: Single-product yield = that product’s output ÷ feed × 100%; total yield = sum of all product outputs ÷ feed × 100%; loss = feed − total products, loss rate = loss ÷ feed × 100%. When the balance is good the total yield is close to 100%.
map.为什么会有损失/残液？: Why is there loss or residue?
map.损失来自塔底残渣、未冷凝轻组分、设备挂壁与计量误差，以及未单独列出的副产品。损失: Losses come from column bottoms residue, uncondensed light components, material clinging to equipment walls and metering errors, plus by-products that are not listed separately. A persistently high loss rate means operation and design should be reviewed, although a small loss is normal in continuous distillation.
map.平衡状态：|损失率| ≤2% 良好｜≤5% 略有偏差｜>5% 偏差较大: Balance state: |loss rate| ≤2% good | ≤5% slight deviation | >5% large deviation
map.蒸馏塔物料平衡与收率计算: Distillation Column Material Balance & Yield Calculation
map.各产品收率 = 产品量 ÷ 进料量 × 100%: Yield per product = product amount ÷ feed amount × 100%
map.总收率 = Σ产品量 ÷ 进料量 × 100%: Total yield = Σ product amounts ÷ feed amount × 100%
map.损失/残液 = 进料量 − 总产品量（吨）: Loss/residue = feed amount − total product amount (t)
map.条形长度 = 该产品收率 ÷ 最高收率 × 100%: Bar length = this product's yield ÷ highest yield × 100%
map.输入校验：进料>0、产品数>0: Input check: feed >0 and product count >0
map.平衡状态：|未闭合率| ≤2% 参考内｜≤5% 略大｜>5% 较大；均须复核: Balance state: |unclosed ratio| ≤ 2% within reference | ≤ 5% slightly large | > 5% large; all need verification
map.未闭合差额 = 进料量 − Σ产品量 − 已知损失/残液（吨）: Unclosed difference = feed − Σ product quantities − known loss/residue (t)
map.未闭合率 = 未闭合差额 ÷ 进料量 × 100%；已知损失可留空: Unclosed ratio = unclosed difference ÷ feed × 100%; known loss may be left blank
map.总量超进料时显示“物料平衡超额”，不输出负损失: When the total exceeds the feed, “mass balance excess” is shown instead of a negative loss
map.留空表示未单独计量损失/残液，结果只显示未闭合差额，不把差额直接当作真实损失。: Leave blank if loss/residue is not measured separately; the result then shows only the unclosed difference, which is not treated as the actual loss.
map.= 进料量 − 总产品量 − 已知损失/残液 = 未闭合差额（不等于真实损失）: = feed − total products − known loss/residue = unclosed difference (not the actual loss)
map.各产品产量逐项填写；0 须明确填 0，留空表示未知并停止平衡计算，避免把缺项当: Enter each product quantity; a real zero must be entered as 0, while blank means unknown and stops the balance calculation so a missing item is never treated as zero.
map.已知损失/残液可单独填写，未单列时只显示“未闭合差额”，不把差额直接称作真实损失: Known loss/residue can be entered separately; if not itemized, only the “unclosed difference” is shown and it is not called the actual loss.
map.产品+损失超过进料时显示“物料平衡超额”和超出量，不再输出负损失；并复核重复计量: When products plus loss exceed the feed, “mass balance excess” and the excess amount are shown instead of a negative loss; verify double counting or product allocation.
map.称按纯文本显示，输入尖括号或事件属性不会被当作 HTML 执行。: is displayed as plain text; angle brackets or event attributes entered are not executed as HTML.
Feed 1000 t, ethylene 480 t, propylene 290 t, with the rest not itemized. Ethylene 48.0%, propylene 29.0%, total products 770 t, total yield 77.0%; the unclosed difference is 230 t (23.0%), only the gap from unlisted loss/residue and not the actual loss.
